description: This file defines the ConnectionManager class in Kotlin, managing network connections, TLS parameters, device capabilities, and client information for an Android application.

classes.name: ConnectionManager
classes.description: Manages network connectivity, TLS configuration, device capabilities, and client information for the app.

methods.name: resolveTlsParamsForEndpoint
methods.description: Determines TLS parameters for a given network endpoint based on stored fingerprints and endpoint settings.

methods.name: runtimeFlags
methods.description: Generates runtime flags indicating device capabilities and configuration.

methods.name: buildInvokeCommands
methods.description: Builds a list of supported invoke commands based on runtime flags.

methods.name: buildCapabilities
methods.description: Builds a list of capabilities based on runtime flags.

methods.name: resolvedVersionName
methods.description: Determines the app's version name, appending '-dev' if in debug mode.

methods.name: resolveModelIdentifier
methods.description: Constructs a device model identifier from manufacturer and model info.

methods.name: buildUserAgent
methods.description: Builds the user agent string for the app.

methods.name: buildClientInfo
methods.description: Creates client info object with device and app details.

methods.name: buildNodeConnectOptions
methods.description: Constructs options for connecting as a node.

methods.name: buildOperatorConnectOptions
methods.description: Constructs options for connecting as an operator.

methods.name: resolveTlsParams
methods.description: Resolves TLS parameters for a specific endpoint using stored preferences.
